note: Season purse: a design. Nothing has launched: no Wattness factory, Launcher, Vault, PRIX token or deposit exists, so the presale tube and the vault are empty and the allocation screen shows the rules, not counts. Real: the Flap Portal's live configuration on BSC testnet (frame-data.json sponsors.flap: Portal v1.2.0, block 144,817,512 at 10:09:42 CT, creation open, salt-lock fee 0.005 tBNB) and its floors at half the supply in the pool, $1,500 to create and $3,000 to graduate; the tube's brass marks stand at those floors on a linear scale whose graduation floor is 90% of the tube (the ratio is the Portal's, the scale the design's). PRIX is a placeholder held in one constant (season.ts SEASON_TOKEN): the organizers have not said whether 'no token tickers' covers testnet tokens. The visitor is the kit's figure for scale; the bulbs chase at 0.8 Hz. The License to launch tower stands east of the frame, so it is not in this view.
